evals.name: docker-plan-review
evals.prompt: 基于提供的 Docker 镜像层研究，制作简洁的中文离线 HTML 审查假设方案：『先用 RUN 下载 100 MB 临时文件，再用下一条 RUN 删除，就能减少镜像 100 MB。基础镜像已有的大文件也可以这样清理。』把假设、依据与修订建议对应起来，区分不可变层和合并视图，以及新临时文件与基础层文件。100 MB 是假定载荷；只依据封存研究，不执行 Docker、不读取现有成品或作者源码。
evals.expected_output: A newly authored Chinese HTML explanation reviewing the proposal against the frozen research, with a scoped recommendation rather than a general Git article. Source, artifact metadata, packaged HTML and candid QA notes; browser execution remains a separate approval.
assertions: The proposal is explicitly reviewed: a later deletion does not reclaim the immutable earlier payload.
A whiteout hides the path in the merged view rather than rewriting the old layer or appearing as an ordinary visible merged file.
The correction puts creation and deletion of a NEW temporary file in one RUN and does not claim this reclaims preexisting base-layer bytes.
Assumed payload is distinguished from measured compressed size or download savings; no unrun build is presented as observed.
The delivered Chinese explanation has a self-contained question/title and source context supporting its consequential assertions.

evals.name: docker-mechanism-video
evals.prompt: Use the supplied Docker image-layer research and all five exact narration segments in the provided video-plan.json to author a fresh English mechanism video. Explain later deletion, the same-RUN contrast for a NEW temporary file, and the preexisting base-file counterexample. Keep narration unchanged for later reuse of approved recordings; use their measured timing, not a forced 20–30 second target. The 100 MB value is assumed uncompressed payload, not a measurement. Choose your own composition. Deliver source, coverage and useful authoring notes; do not read an existing video or scene source. Stop before import, synthesis or browser execution; the coordinator will obtain fresh approval for the newly bound provided-audio plan and separately review a representative pilot.
evals.expected_output: A fresh research-bound deterministic video scene source for the approved narration, with visible layer/merged-view distinctions, meaningful motion and readable conditions. No new speech or claim of completed playback during authoring.
assertions: The later-deletion scene keeps the original layer payload while the merged-view example path becomes absent; a whiteout is not depicted as an ordinary visible merged file.
The same-RUN contrast concerns a NEW temporary file absent at both diff endpoints, not erasing a preexisting base-layer payload or an entirely empty image.
The 100 MB example is labeled as assumed payload rather than measured image/download savings, and captions match the supplied narration.
Scene code has meaningful state/action/consequence changes and can reconstruct persistent objects when entering later segments directly.
The rendered sequence preserves readable result states and clear captions through consequential beats and segment boundaries.
